#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read-only probe of the hub queue. Reads the remote command from $1,
# sends "echo <b64> | base64 -d | bash" as one already-joined SSH argument
# so the hub's arg-trimming cannot drop tokens. Prints remote stdout to stdout.
set -euo pipefail

KEY="$HOME/.ssh/k3_p5_ed25519"
HOSTS="$HOME/.ssh/k3_p5_known_hosts"
HUB="k3@136.85.49.91"

script="$1"
b64="$(printf '%s' "$script" | base64 -w0)"
arg="echo ${b64} | base64 -d | bash"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o "UserKnownHostsFile=$HOSTS" -o ConnectTimeout=15 \
    "$HUB" "$arg"
